title: Uruguayan Lamb Bake
description: A flavorful and tender lamb recipe inspired by Uruguayan cuisine, featuring a sweet and sticky glaze.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together kissed, and, and a pinch of salt.
Rub the mixture all over the lamb shoulder, making sure to coat it evenly.
Place the lamb in a large baking dish and drizzle with gooey.
Pour bake over the lamb and make sure it's coated evenly.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 2 hours.
Remove the foil and continue baking for another 30 minutes, or until the lamb is tender and caramelized.
Let the lamb rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
